findings.issue: The parser still fails open on malformed or non-verdict marker streams in both workflows. Exact execution showed green for: a fresh PASS followed by a newer unterminated FAIL block; a complete PASS example inside a Markdown code fence; and an interleaved foreign verdict whose current Agent-run is combined with the outer block's PASS. Thus Status and Agent-run share one awk buffer, but not necessarily one logical verdict.
findings.suggestion: Parse comment-aware, fence-aware blocks and reject malformed transitions, dangling latest opens, nested/interleaved verdict markers, and duplicate Status/Agent-run fields. Add all these cases for both marker types.

findings.issue: The harness genuinely extracts the awk program, but contrary to lines 10-12 it duplicates the Status and Agent-run grep/sed logic. It therefore would still pass if a shipped workflow later read either field from COMMENTS instead of LATEST. The new test also has no CI invocation in this commit.
findings.suggestion: Exercise the shipped workflow shell logic or extract and verify the actual field-source commands, then wire the harness into CI.

strongest_aspect: For well-formed blocks, the exact committed parsers produce the intended results in both workflows: PASS+FAIL is red, fresh PASS is green, FAIL+PASS is green, and stale or zero blocks are red. The workflow changes are mechanically identical apart from marker type.
biggest_risk: Raw marker text can still manufacture or preserve a green result without constituting the latest valid logical verdict.
